title: Dinner for Two
content:
Anna wanted to cook dinner for her friend, Mia.

She went to the kitchen and looked at the ingredients.

— We need some rice, water, and oil — Anna said.

Mia opened the fridge.

— There is some milk here. Do we need it?

— No, we don't. But we need some cheese.

They started cooking.

Anna put the rice and water in a pan. Mia added some salt and oil.

— How much rice do we need? — Mia asked.

— About two cups.

After a few minutes, the food was ready.

They put the rice on two plates.

— This rice smells great! — Mia said.

Anna smiled.

— Let's eat!

They sat at the table and enjoyed their dinner together.

— Cooking is easy when we do it together — Mia said.

— And dinner is better with a good friend! — Anna replied.
